name: @cordis-app/bundle-core
description: Cordis Agent Core product bundle: disables the shipped dsh Web React client roster and mounts our own plugins (ui, gateway).
comment_dependencies: Deliberately none here — pnpm's hoisted linker (pnpm-workspace.yaml) creates a REAL, separate node_modules copy for any dependency declared directly on a workspace package, which produced a TypeScript duplicate-identity error (two different @deepseek-ai/dsh-session paths, one per copy) for the exact same version. Every @deepseek-ai/dsh-* package this bundle imports is declared once, at the root package.json, and resolved here via plain Node upward directory-walk resolution through the single hoisted root node_modules.
